up: Retrieve distinct compounds with their ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES from assays targeting 'bromodomain-containing protein 4' in Homo sapiens. Order the results by ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM compound_structures cs JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cs.molregno = md.molregno JOIN activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.pref_name = 'bromodomain-containing protein 4' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
